title: SG-OPD: Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation via Sign-Consistency Gating and Phased Teacher Sampling
title_zh: SG-OPD：通过符号一致性门控与分阶段教师采样实现符号门控的 On-Policy Distillation
abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories with dense per-token supervision from a stronger teacher, and often outperforms off-policy distillation and standard reinforcement learning. However, we find that its effectiveness implicitly relies on two assumptions that frequently break in practice: trajectory-level alignment between the student and the teacher, and uniform token-level reliability of the teacher's preferences. We therefore propose Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation (SG-OPD), which uses a binary verifier as a trust signal for the teacher at two complementary granularities: phased teacher sampling mixes in verifier-endorsed teacher rollouts at cold-start, and a sign-consistency gate extrapolates the distillation update on tokens where the teacher agrees with the verifier-correct direction and interpolates it where it disagrees. Experiments on competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that SG-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD, with average gains of 1.98 and 7.50 at the per-sample and per-question levels, respectively.
abstract_zh: On-policy distillation（OPD）在学生模型自身生成的轨迹上训练，并从更强的教师模型获得逐 token 的密集监督，通常优于 off-policy distillation 和标准强化学习。然而，作者发现 OPD 的有效性隐含依赖两个实践中常被破坏的假设：学生与教师在轨迹层面的对齐，以及教师偏好在所有 token 上都同等可靠。为此，论文提出 Sign-Gated On-Policy Distillation（SG-OPD），利用二元 verifier 作为教师可信度信号，并在两个互补粒度上发挥作用：首先，在冷启动阶段通过 phased teacher sampling 混入 verifier 认可的教师 rollout；其次，通过 sign-consistency gate，在教师与 verifier 判定的正确方向一致的 token 上外推蒸馏更新，在不一致的 token 上插值更新。实验表明，在竞赛级数学推理基准上，SG-OPD 稳定优于标准 OPD，按样本和按题目统计的平均增益分别为 1.98 和 7.50。
key_points_zh: 指出标准 OPD 依赖两个脆弱假设：学生-教师轨迹级对齐，以及教师逐 token 偏好的均匀可靠性。
提出 SG-OPD，引入 binary verifier 作为教师监督是否可信的外部信号。
phased teacher sampling 在冷启动阶段采样 verifier 认可的教师轨迹，缓解学生早期轨迹质量低、与教师不对齐的问题。
sign-consistency gate 根据教师方向与 verifier-correct direction 是否一致，对 token 级蒸馏更新进行外推或插值。
在竞赛级数学推理 benchmarks 上，SG-OPD 相比标准 OPD 获得稳定提升，per-sample 与 per-question 平均增益分别为 1.98 和 7.50。

llm_assessment.comment: SG-OPD is a useful verifier-aided distillation method, but its focus on math reasoning makes it only weakly relevant to agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: SG-OPD 是有用的验证器辅助蒸馏方法，但其数学推理定位使其与智能体 Harness 演化的相关性较弱。
